# KKME

> Baltic flexibility and storage market intelligence. Live supply/demand data,
> balancing-market prices and reference-asset economics for grid-scale battery
> storage in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia.

Independent, single-operator. Built by Kastytis Kemezys. https://kkme.eu

## What this site publishes

Every figure below is computed from a named upstream source and refreshed on a
stated cadence. Nothing here is an estimate presented as an observation; where a
number is modelled rather than measured, the site says so on the surface that
shows it.

- **Day-ahead price separation (S1)** — Lithuanian and SE4 day-ahead prices, the
  spread between them, and the perfect-foresight arbitrage capture a 2h and 4h
  battery could take from the day's curve. Source: ENTSO-E transparency platform
  and energy-charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE). Refreshed every 4 hours.
- **Balancing-market prices (S2)** — aFRR, mFRR and FCR capacity and activation
  clearing prices for the Baltic bidding zones. Source: Baltic Transparency
  Dashboard. Refreshed daily.
- **Cost stack (S3)** — lithium carbonate and LFP system-price proxies feeding
  the CAPEX assumptions. Refreshed daily.
- **Grid connection capacity (S4)** — free, connected and reserved capacity for
  storage at the Lithuanian transmission level, plus the tracked Baltic storage
  fleet. Source: Litgrid open data. Refreshed daily.
- **Reference-asset economics** — first-year revenue, EBITDA, IRR and DSCR for a
  parameterised Baltic BESS, computed on live market data at request time.

## Update cadence

Signals refresh on a 4-hourly cron, with an hourly pass for the time-sensitive
series. Freshness per key is published at
https://kkme-fetch-s1.kastis-kemezys.workers.dev/health — including which
signals are currently stale or degraded. That endpoint is the honest answer to
"is this number current", and it is preferable to inferring currency from a
page's appearance.

## Citation

Citation is welcome, with attribution to **KKME (kkme.eu)** and a link to the
page the figure is on.

Two requests, both of which exist because the alternative misleads a reader:

1. **Cite the figure with its date.** Everything here moves. A number quoted
   without the date it was read is not reproducible, and several of these series
   change several times a day.
2. **Do not restate a modelled figure as an observed one.** The revenue, IRR and
   DSCR outputs are model results from stated assumptions, not measurements. The
   assumptions and their sources are published at https://kkme.eu/methodology.

## What is not published

- The fleet console at /fleet is private and requires authentication.
- Counterparty names, client identities and contracted figures are never
  published anywhere on this site, by policy.

## Machine-readable

- Methodology: https://kkme.eu/methodology
- Health and per-signal freshness: https://kkme-fetch-s1.kastis-kemezys.workers.dev/health
- Sitemap: https://kkme.eu/sitemap.xml

## Model training

`robots.txt` declares `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference`
and disallows the major training crawlers by name. Reading this site to answer a
question and citing it is welcome. Using it as training data is not.
